leaseholdType.title: What is the type of property included in the lease?

details.title: Please supply further details and any documents relating to the variation:

isManagingAgentEmployed.title: Is a managing agent appointed to manage the building and collect service charges?

hasTenantCompanyDissolved.title: Are you aware of any company responsible for managing the building having been dissolved or struck off the register at Companies House?

dangerousCladdingOrDefects.title: Are you aware of the existence or suspected existence in the building of cladding or any defects that may create a building safety risk?

sellerReceivedComplaint.title: Are you aware of any complaint received from the landlord, the management company or any neighbour about anything you have or have not done?

sellerSentComplaint.title: Are you aware of any complaint made to or about the landlord, the management company, or any neighbour?

isLeaseQualifying.title: Is the property within a relevant building (11 metres or more in height or at least 5 storeys and contains at least 2 dwellings) and is not leaseholder-owned?

attachments.title: Please supply a copy of the leaseholder deed of certificate and the accompanying evidence.

deedOfCertificateServed.title: Is there a leaseholder deed of certificate for the property?

landlordNotifiedOfSale.title: Has the landlord been notified of your intention to sell the property?

attachments.title: Please supply a copy of the landlord’s certificate and the accompanying evidence.

landlordsCertificateServed.title: Have you received a landlord’s certificate and the accompanying evidence?

sellerServedNoticeOnLandlord.title: Have you served on the landlord a notice stating your wish to buy the freehold or be granted an extended lease?

sellerAwareOfNoticeOfCollectivePurchase.title: Are you aware of the service of any notice relating to the possible collective purchase of the freehold of the building or part of it by a group of tenants?

noticeOfSale.title: Have you received a notice that the landlord wants to sell the building?

noticeOfBuildingCondition.title: Have you received any other notice about the building, its use, its condition or its repair and maintenance?

attachments.title: Please provide details of the remediation works proposed and evidence of any carried out.

buildingSafety.title: Have any remediation works on the building been proposed or carried out?
